def: a person trapped in the dungeon who must fight to survive
ex: Every crawler must find the stairs before the timer ends.
exCs: Každý crawler musí najít schody, než vyprší čas.

def: a dark place under the ground, full of monsters and traps
ex: The dungeon has eighteen floors, and each one is worse.
exCs: Dungeon má osmnáct pater a každé je horší.

def: one level of a building or of the dungeon; also the ground you stand on
ex: We need to reach the next floor before it collapses.
exCs: Musíme se dostat do dalšího patra, než se zřítí.

def: the space with stairs that goes down to the next level
ex: Carl ran toward the stairwell with Donut on his shoulder.
exCs: Carl běžel ke schodišti s Donut na rameni.

def: a room where monsters cannot attack you and you can rest
ex: They slept in the safe room and ate some terrible food.
exCs: Spali v bezpečné místnosti a snědli nějaké hrozné jídlo.

def: to become stronger in a game after getting enough experience
ex: After killing the rats, Carl leveled up twice.
exCs: Po zabití krys Carl dvakrát postoupil na vyšší úroveň.

def: points you get for fighting and finishing tasks; enough points let you level up
ex: Each goblin gave them a little experience.
exCs: Každý goblin jim dal trochu zkušeností.

def: how much damage you can take before you die
ex: His health was low, so he drank a potion.
exCs: Měl málo životů, tak vypil lektvar.

def: the energy you use to cast spells
ex: Donut ran out of mana in the middle of the fight.
exCs: Donut došla mana uprostřed boje.

def: things you take from enemies or find in the dungeon; to take these things
ex: The monster dropped some loot: two coins and a dirty sock.
exCs: Z monstra vypadla kořist: dvě mince a špinavá ponožka.

def: a box you get as a prize; you open it to see what is inside
ex: Donut wanted to open her loot box right away.
exCs: Donut chtěla svou truhlu s odměnou otevřít hned.

def: the magic storage where a crawler keeps their items
ex: He put the rope and the hammer in his inventory.
exCs: Dal provaz a kladivo do inventáře.

def: a task in a game that gives you a reward when you finish it
ex: The quest was simple: kill ten rats in the hallway.
exCs: Úkol byl jednoduchý: zabít deset krys na chodbě.

def: a special message and prize you get for doing something unusual
ex: New achievement! You kicked a monster in the face.
exCs: Nový úspěch! Kopl jsi monstrum do obličeje.

def: a very strong enemy, usually at the end of an area
ex: The boss was three times bigger than the other monsters.
exCs: Boss byl třikrát větší než ostatní monstra.

def: in games: any monster you can fight; in normal English: a big angry crowd
ex: A mob of goblins came around the corner.
exCs: Zpoza rohu přišla tlupa goblinů.

def: when a monster notices you and starts to attack you
ex: Don't make noise or you will pull aggro from the whole room.
exCs: Nedělej hluk, nebo na sebe upozorníš celou místnost.

def: something that makes you stronger for a short time
ex: The potion gave him a buff to his strength.
exCs: Lektvar mu dočasně posílil sílu.

def: something bad that makes you weaker for a short time, like poison
ex: The slime gave Carl a debuff, and his legs felt heavy.
exCs: Sliz Carla oslabil a nohy mu ztěžkly.

def: when a monster or item suddenly appears in the game
ex: New monsters spawn in this room every hour.
exCs: V této místnosti se každou hodinu objevují nová monstra.

def: numbers that show how strong, fast or smart your character is
ex: Carl checked his stats after the battle.
exCs: Carl si po bitvě zkontroloval statistiky.

def: how physically strong you are
ex: With more strength, he could punch harder.
exCs: S větší silou mohl udeřit silněji.

def: how tough your body is and how much damage you can take
ex: High constitution means you are hard to kill.
exCs: Vysoká odolnost znamená, že tě nejde snadno zabít.

def: how fast and skillful your hands and body are
ex: Donut has amazing dexterity because she is a cat.
exCs: Donut má úžasnou obratnost, protože je kočka.

def: how much people like you and listen to you
ex: Donut put all her points into charisma.
exCs: Donut dala všechny body do charismatu.

def: something you can do well, and that gets better when you practice
ex: His punching skill went up to level three.
exCs: Jeho dovednost úderu se zvýšila na úroveň tři.

def: magic words or power that make something happen
ex: She cast a spell, and the goblin flew across the room.
exCs: Seslala kouzlo a goblin přeletěl přes místnost.

def: the time you must wait before you can use a power again
ex: The spell has a cooldown of five minutes.
exCs: Kouzlo jde znovu použít až za pět minut.

def: a magic drink, for example one that heals you
ex: The healing potion tasted like old lemons.
exCs: Léčivý lektvar chutnal jako staré citrony.

def: to become healthy again, or to make someone healthy again
ex: His broken toe healed after a night of sleep.
exCs: Zlomený palec u nohy se mu po noci spánku zahojil.

def: harm done to someone or something
ex: The explosion did a lot of damage.
exCs: Výbuch způsobil velké škody.

def: a lucky attack that does much more damage than normal
ex: One critical hit, and the rat was gone.
exCs: Jeden kritický zásah a krysa byla pryč.

def: the clothes, weapons and tools you use
ex: Carl had terrible gear: shorts and a jacket.
exCs: Carl měl hroznou výbavu: trenýrky a bundu.

def: hard clothes that protect your body in a fight
ex: He wished he had real armor instead of a jacket.
exCs: Přál si, aby měl místo bundy pořádnou zbroj.

def: a strong glove worn for fighting
ex: He punched the wall with his gauntlet and it cracked.
exCs: Udeřil do zdi bojovou rukavicí a zeď praskla.

def: someone who gives you money or gifts because they like you
ex: If the viewers love you, you might get a sponsor.
exCs: Když tě diváci milují, můžeš získat sponzora.

def: people who watch a show
ex: Billions of viewers watch the crawlers every day.
exCs: Miliardy diváků sledují crawlery každý den.

def: numbers that show how many people watch a show
ex: Donut cares a lot about her ratings.
exCs: Donut hodně záleží na své sledovanosti.

def: a lesson that teaches you how something works
ex: Mordecai's tutorial was short and very rude.
exCs: Mordecaiova výuka byla krátká a hodně nezdvořilá.

def: a group or building for people who do the same job
ex: They found the training guild behind a hidden door.
exCs: Cvičný cech našli za skrytými dveřmi.

def: something good you get because you did something
ex: The reward for the quest was a bronze box.
exCs: Odměnou za úkol byla bronzová truhla.

def: a hidden thing that hurts or catches you when you touch it
ex: Carl stepped over the trap very carefully.
exCs: Carl velmi opatrně překročil past.

def: a clock that counts down to zero
ex: The timer said they had two days left.
exCs: Odpočet ukazoval, že jim zbývají dva dny.

def: in games: the type of fighter you are, like a warrior or a mage
ex: Choosing a class is a big decision in the dungeon.
exCs: Výběr povolání je v dungeonu velké rozhodnutí.

def: a message that suddenly appears to tell you something
ex: A notification appeared in front of his eyes.
exCs: Před očima se mu objevilo oznámení.

def: loose underwear for men
ex: He went into the dungeon wearing only boxer shorts and a jacket.
exCs: Šel do dungeonu jen v trenýrkách a bundě.

def: a jacket made from animal skin
ex: His leather jacket was the only good thing he owned.
exCs: Kožená bunda byla jediná dobrá věc, kterou měl.

def: not wearing any shoes or socks
ex: Walking barefoot in the dungeon was a bad idea.
exCs: Chodit v dungeonu naboso byl špatný nápad.

def: a cat that wins prizes at cat competitions
ex: Donut reminds everyone that she is a champion show cat.
exCs: Donut všem připomíná, že je šampionka mezi výstavními kočkami.

def: a creature from another planet
ex: The aliens turned the whole world into a game show.
exCs: Mimozemšťané proměnili celý svět v televizní soutěž.

def: a TV program where people play games to win prizes
ex: It is not just a dungeon. It is a game show.
exCs: Není to jen dungeon. Je to televizní soutěž.

def: to move quickly so something does not hit you
ex: Carl dodged the spear and hit back.
exCs: Carl uhnul oštěpu a vrátil úder.

def: to quickly lower your head or body to avoid something
ex: He ducked as the bottle flew over his head.
exCs: Skrčil se, když mu láhev přeletěla nad hlavou.

def: to move forward suddenly to attack
ex: The goblin lunged at Donut with a knife.
exCs: Goblin se vrhl na Donut s nožem.

def: to step down very hard, often on something
ex: Carl stomped on the cockroach with his bare foot.
exCs: Carl zašlápl švába bosou nohou.

def: to break something into pieces with force
ex: He smashed the jar against the wall.
exCs: Rozbil sklenici o zeď.

def: to push someone or something hard and rudely
ex: She shoved him out of the way.
exCs: Odstrčila ho z cesty.

def: to take something quickly with your hand
ex: Grab the box and run!
exCs: Popadni truhlu a utíkej!

def: to pull something suddenly and strongly
ex: He yanked the arrow out of his leg.
exCs: Vytrhl si šíp z nohy.

def: to throw something very hard
ex: Carl hurled the bomb down the hallway.
exCs: Carl mrštil bombu do chodby.

def: to throw something lightly or carelessly
ex: She tossed the empty bottle on the floor.
exCs: Pohodila prázdnou láhev na zem.

def: to hit or close something with a lot of force and noise
ex: He slammed the door before the monsters got in.
exCs: Zabouchl dveře dřív, než se monstra dostala dovnitř.

def: to press something so hard that it breaks or becomes flat
ex: The falling stone crushed the goblin.
exCs: Padající kámen goblina rozdrtil.

def: to break into many small pieces
ex: The glass shattered when the creature screamed.
exCs: Sklo se roztříštilo, když stvoření zakřičelo.

def: to make a small sudden movement because you are scared or hurt
ex: Donut did not even flinch when the door exploded.
exCs: Donut ani necukla, když dveře vybuchly.

def: to make a face because something hurts
ex: Carl winced when he stood on his bad foot.
exCs: Carl se zašklebil bolestí, když se postavil na bolavou nohu.

def: to almost fall while walking
ex: He stumbled over a body in the dark.
exCs: Ve tmě zakopl o tělo.

def: to move quietly so nobody sees or hears you
ex: They tried to sneak past the sleeping monster.
exCs: Pokusili se proplížit kolem spícího monstra.

def: to burst with a loud noise and fire
ex: The barrel exploded and the whole room shook.
exCs: Sud vybuchl a celá místnost se otřásla.

def: to lose blood
ex: His arm was bleeding, but he kept fighting.
exCs: Ruka mu krvácela, ale bojoval dál.

def: to make a short low sound, often when working hard or annoyed
ex: Carl grunted and lifted the heavy door.
exCs: Carl zabručel a zvedl těžké dveře.

def: to make a low angry sound, like a dog
ex: Something in the dark growled at them.
exCs: Něco ve tmě na ně zavrčelo.

def: to make a long 'sss' sound, like a snake or an angry cat
ex: Donut hissed at the goblin.
exCs: Donut na goblina zasyčela.

def: to scream in a very high voice
ex: The creature shrieked and ran away.
exCs: Stvoření zaječelo a uteklo.

def: to speak quietly, often because you are unhappy
ex: 'This is stupid,' Carl muttered.
exCs: „Tohle je hloupost,“ zamumlal Carl.

def: to breathe in suddenly because you are surprised or in pain
ex: Donut gasped when she saw the price.
exCs: Donut zalapala po dechu, když uviděla cenu.

def: to push air out of your nose loudly, often to laugh at something
ex: Mordecai snorted. 'You won't last a day.'
exCs: Mordecai si odfrkl. „Nevydržíte ani den.“

def: very unpleasant to see, smell or touch (informal)
ex: Ew, that is so gross!
exCs: Fuj, to je tak hnusné!

def: so bad that it makes you feel sick
ex: The sandwich from the safe room was disgusting.
exCs: Sendvič z bezpečné místnosti byl odporný.

def: strange in a way that makes you feel scared
ex: The empty hallway was quiet and creepy.
exCs: Prázdná chodba byla tichá a strašidelná.

def: covered with a wet, sticky substance
ex: The walls of the tunnel were green and slimy.
exCs: Stěny tunelu byly zelené a slizké.

def: something that holds onto things that touch it, like glue
ex: His feet were sticky with something he did not want to know about.
exCs: Nohy měl ulepené něčím, o čem nechtěl nic vědět.

def: very, very big
ex: A massive shape moved in the darkness.
exCs: Ve tmě se pohnul obrovský stín.

def: so silly or strange that it is almost funny
ex: Donut's new hat was ridiculous, but she loved it.
exCs: Nový klobouček Donut byl směšný, ale ona ho milovala.

def: extremely tired
ex: After the fight, they were too exhausted to talk.
exCs: Po boji byli příliš vyčerpaní, aby mluvili.

def: extremely afraid
ex: Carl was terrified, but he did not run.
exCs: Carl byl k smrti vyděšený, ale neutekl.

def: extremely angry
ex: Donut was furious that nobody noticed her.
exCs: Donut zuřila, že si jí nikdo nevšiml.

def: a very bad smell
ex: The stench in the sewer made his eyes water.
exCs: Z puchu v kanalizaci mu slzely oči.

def: a dead body
ex: He searched the goblin's corpse for loot.
exCs: Prohledal goblinovu mrtvolu, jestli u ní nenajde kořist.

def: the inside parts of a body; also (informal) courage
ex: It takes guts to punch a monster in the face.
exCs: Dát monstru pěstí do obličeje chce odvahu.

def: broken pieces of stone and brick from a building
ex: They climbed over the rubble of the old building.
exCs: Přelezli přes trosky staré budovy.

def: a long narrow passage inside a building
ex: The hallway seemed to go on forever.
exCs: Chodba jako by neměla konce.

def: the top surface of a room, above your head
ex: Something was moving on the ceiling.
exCs: Na stropě se něco hýbalo.

def: underground pipes or tunnels that carry dirty water away
ex: The only way forward was through the sewer.
exCs: Jediná cesta dál vedla kanalizací.

def: a small smile that shows you think you are better than someone
ex: Donut smirked when Carl fell in the mud.
exCs: Donut se ušklíbla, když Carl spadl do bláta.

def: to lift your shoulders to show you don't know or don't care
ex: Carl just shrugged. He had no idea.
exCs: Carl jen pokrčil rameny. Neměl tušení.

def: saying the opposite of what you mean, to be funny or unkind
ex: 'Oh, great plan,' Mordecai said in a sarcastic voice.
exCs: „Ó, skvělý plán,“ řekl Mordecai jízlivě.

def: to understand something or find the answer after thinking
ex: We need to figure out how to open this door.
exCs: Musíme přijít na to, jak otevřít tyhle dveře.

def: to suddenly become very scared, angry or excited (informal)
ex: Don't freak out, but there is a spider on your back.
exCs: Nevyšiluj, ale máš na zádech pavouka.

def: to stop trying
ex: Carl was tired, but he would not give up.
exCs: Carl byl unavený, ale nevzdal by to.

def: to have none of something left
ex: They were about to run out of food.
exCs: Brzy jim mělo dojít jídlo.

def: to move away from someone or stop pushing them
ex: 'Back off!' Carl shouted at the goblins.
exCs: „Ustupte!“ zakřičel Carl na gobliny.

def: to try to make people notice how good you are
ex: Donut loves to show off for the cameras.
exCs: Donut se ráda předvádí před kamerami.

def: wait a moment; or hold something tightly
ex: Hang on, I think I heard something.
exCs: Počkej, myslím, že jsem něco slyšel.

cs: právě se chystat, mít se (něco stát)
def: to be going to do something very soon
ex: The boss fight was about to start.
exCs: Souboj s bossem měl právě začít.

def: in informal English, 'pretty' before an adjective means 'quite'
ex: I'm pretty sure that thing wants to eat us.
exCs: Jsem si docela jistý, že nás ta věc chce sníst.

def: a soft way to say 'I think' or 'probably' (informal)
ex: I guess we have to go down the stairs.
exCs: Asi musíme jít dolů po schodech.

def: used to change the topic or to say something happens in spite of a problem
ex: It was dangerous, but they went anyway.
exCs: Bylo to nebezpečné, ale stejně šli.

def: a rude way to show surprise or anger
ex: What the hell is that thing?
exCs: Co to sakra je za věc?

def: in a very bad situation with no easy way out (informal)
ex: If that door doesn't open, we're screwed.
exCs: Jestli se ty dveře neotevřou, jsme v háji.

def: a rude way to show you are very surprised
ex: Holy crap, did you see how big that was?
exCs: Ty vole, viděl jsi, jak to bylo velký?

def: an informal word for a man or friend
ex: Dude, you are not wearing pants.
exCs: Kámo, nemáš na sobě kalhoty.

cs: v žádném případě; to není možné
def: definitely not; or 'I can't believe it'
ex: No way. I am not going in there.
exCs: V žádném případě. Tam nejdu.

def: very angry (rude, informal)
ex: The monster looked really pissed off.
exCs: Monstrum vypadalo pořádně naštvaně.

def: a tough, cool person; or very cool (informal)
ex: Donut thinks she looks badass in her new armor.
exCs: Donut si myslí, že v nové zbroji vypadá drsně.

def: to beat someone easily in a fight (rude, informal)
ex: Let's go kick some ass.
exCs: Pojďme někomu nakopat zadek.
